elements.title: Cycle Domain Adaptation (CycDA) Loss

figure.caption: Integration of CycDA Loss within the feature extraction architecture

bullets: Mitigates domain gaps from camera specifications and environmental changes
Minimizes L2 discrepancies across ground, satellite, and latent feature spaces
Enforces view-invariant representations for robust bidirectional feature translation

builds.audio_segment: CycDA loss bridges the domain gap from varying camera specs and lighting.
This component mitigates domain gaps arising from different camera specifications and environmental changes.
It minimizes L2 distances across ground, satellite, and shared latent spaces.
This bidirectional adaptation ensures features are view-invariant and translatable, providing a robust foundation for cross-view matching.
